answer: Attention-Lock Identity Windows. Each identity may act only inside a slot unlocked by a costly sustained-attention proof: a zephyr of continuous, verifiable task focus streamed to validators. Reusing one slot across parallel personas forces detectable attention dilution, like splitting a walnut shell. Duplicate attempts must repay the full attention cost per slot, priced near the marginal value of a dedicated human operator, making N sybils cost N times one honest participant's sustained focus. A quill signs each window's closure.
